findings.problem: The smsc_id column contains text names like 'Orange' instead of numeric IDs, breaking links to the master smsc table.
findings.fix: Map SMSC names to numeric IDs and cast column to integer
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sent_sms_clean (LIKE sent_sms INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO sent_sms_clean SELECT * FROM sent_sms ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE sent_sms_clean ss SET smsc_id = s.id::text FROM smsc s WHERE ss.smsc_id = s.name;
ALTER TABLE sent_sms_clean ALTER COLUMN smsc_id TYPE integer USING smsc_id::integer;
ALTER TABLE sent_sms_clean ADD CONSTRAINT fk_sent_sms_smsc FOREIGN KEY (smsc_id) REFERENCES smsc(id);
findings.explanation: This fix converts descriptive gateway names into their corresponding numeric identifiers from the smsc table, then enforces strict data typing and referential integrity.

findings.problem: Contact IDs are stored as bigints while the master contact list uses text, causing 31 records to become disconnected.
findings.fix: Align contact ID types and remove orphans
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campagne_contacts_clean (LIKE campagne_contacts INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO campagne_contacts_clean SELECT * FROM campagne_contacts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
DELETE FROM campagne_contacts_clean WHERE contact_id::text NOT IN (SELECT msisdn FROM contacts);
ALTER TABLE campagne_contacts_clean ALTER COLUMN contact_id TYPE character varying USING contact_id::character varying;
ALTER TABLE campagne_contacts_clean ADD CONSTRAINT fk_campagne_contacts_contact FOREIGN KEY (contact_id) REFERENCES contacts(msisdn);
findings.explanation: By converting the ID column to text and removing records that don't exist in the master contacts table, we restore the ability to correctly link campaigns to recipients.

findings.problem: Organization 2 has multiple identical default routing rules, which makes message delivery unpredictable.
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS smsc_routing_rule_clean (LIKE smsc_routing_rule INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO smsc_routing_rule_clean SELECT * FROM smsc_routing_rule ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;

DELETE FROM smsc_routing_rule_clean WHERE organization_id = 2 AND expediteur_id IS NULL AND groupe_id IS NULL AND id NOT IN (SELECT MIN(id) FROM smsc_routing_rule_clean WHERE organization_id = 2 AND expediteur_id IS NULL AND groupe_id IS NULL);
findings.explanation: This removes duplicate 'catch-all' rules for the specific organization, ensuring the system always uses a single deterministic path for SMS routing.

findings.problem: Eight group records are missing an administrator, leaving them without ownership or access control.
findings.fix: Assign orphaned groups to a default administrator
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groupe_clean (LIKE groupe INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO groupe_clean SELECT * FROM groupe ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE groupe_clean SET admin_id = (SELECT id FROM users_legacy LIMIT 1) WHERE admin_id IS NULL;
findings.explanation: Assigns a fallback administrator from the legacy users table to ensure every group has a valid owner for security and management purposes.

findings.problem: Four user missions are not linked to any group, which may bypass organizational permission checks.
findings.fix: Purge missions with missing group links
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_mission_clean (LIKE user_mission INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO user_mission_clean SELECT * FROM user_mission ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
DELETE FROM user_mission_clean WHERE groupe_id IS NULL;
findings.explanation: Removes incomplete mission records that lack a group context, preventing potential security gaps in the permission hierarchy.

findings.problem: The campaign tags table lacks a primary key, which allows duplicate tags to be assigned to the same campaign.
findings.fix: Remove duplicate tags and add primary key
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campagne_tags_clean (LIKE campagne_tags INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO campagne_tags_clean SELECT * FROM campagne_tags ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
DELETE FROM campagne_tags_clean WHERE ctid NOT IN (SELECT MIN(ctid) FROM campagne_tags_clean GROUP BY campagne_id, tag_name);
ALTER TABLE campagne_tags_clean ADD PRIMARY KEY (campagne_id, tag_name);
findings.explanation: Cleans up any existing duplicate tag assignments and enforces a unique constraint to prevent future data duplication.

findings.problem: 135 audit log entries reference background jobs that no longer exist in the system.
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log_clean (LIKE audit_log INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO audit_log_clean SELECT * FROM audit_log ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
DELETE FROM audit_log_clean WHERE job_id IS NOT NULL AND job_id NOT IN (SELECT id::text FROM jobs);
findings.explanation: Purges logs that point to non-existent jobs, cleaning up the audit trail and improving query performance on log tables.

findings.problem: Seven revision records use the text 'SYSTEM' instead of a standard UUID format for the user identifier.
findings.fix: Standardize system account identifiers to UUID
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rev_info_clean (LIKE rev_info INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO rev_info_clean SELECT * FROM rev_info ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE rev_info_clean SET keycloak_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' WHERE keycloak_id = 'SYSTEM';
findings.explanation: Replaces the non-standard 'SYSTEM' string with a reserved 'nil' UUID to ensure all records in the column follow the same data format.

findings.problem: A redundant unique constraint exists on the status table, causing unnecessary overhead.
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS prm_status_clean (LIKE prm_status INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO prm_status_clean SELECT * FROM prm_status ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
ALTER TABLE prm_status_clean DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ukblxl9et72bx7m3pcwq2nxy9mg;
findings.explanation: Removes an extra database check that is already covered by a simpler unique constraint on the 'code' column.

findings.problem: Old campaign spooler records from early 2025 are still present, indicating stalled processes.
findings.fix: Purge campaign spooler states older than 6 months
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_spool_state_clean (LIKE campaign_spool_state INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO campaign_spool_state_clean SELECT * FROM campaign_spool_state ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
DELETE FROM campaign_spool_state_clean WHERE last_updated_date < NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months';
findings.explanation: Resets the spooler by removing very old state records that likely represent failed or hung campaign tasks.

findings.problem: The sms_type column uses a large numeric type (bigint) for values that only require a small integer.
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sent_sms_clean (LIKE sent_sms INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO sent_sms_clean SELECT * FROM sent_sms ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
ALTER TABLE sent_sms_clean ALTER COLUMN sms_type TYPE smallint;
findings.explanation: Optimizes storage by using a more appropriate data type for the small range of values actually stored in this column.

findings.problem: Searching for contacts by tag is slow because there is no standalone index on the tag_id column.
findings.fix: Add standalone index for tag lookups
queries: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_contact_tags_clean (LIKE user_contact_tags INCLUDING ALL);
INSERT INTO user_contact_tags_clean SELECT * FROM user_contact_tags ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
CREATE INDEX idx_user_contact_tags_tag_id ON user_contact_tags_clean(tag_id);
findings.explanation: Improves the performance of queries that filter or group contacts based on their assigned tags.
